newsitem.title: USA: Butler Natl profits could return this year.
newsitem.headline: Butler Natl profits could return this year.

text.p: Butler National Corp, which reported a loss in the third quarter ended January 31, said Tuesday shipments of new aircraft modification parts could bring the company back to profitability by the end of the current fiscal year.

Butler said the loss of $431,000 in the period, or $0.05 a share, compared to a profit of $6,000, or nil per share, was caused primarily by lower-than-expected margins at its food distribution segment.
Sales in the period totaled $4.9 million, up from $3.7 million one year ago, the company said.
Butler is an aerospace and services business.
Its shares were off 3/16 Tuesday at 2-3/16.
